objective: Clear all reported runtime, Git lock, publisher, queue pickup, browser/DOM acceptance and stale-runner blockers without deleting user data, using force push, reset --hard, or starting a second runner.

canonical_findings.unsafe_reason: Contains git reset --hard and therefore must not be executed under the current recovery contract.

execution_order.name: canonical_drive_and_process_gate
actions: Run only on the portable Windows host where the same volume is mounted as F:.
If the volume is mounted only as H:, assign that existing volume the drive letter F:; do not copy or delete data.
Verify zero or one canonical runner process; abort if more than one exists.

execution_order.name: preserve_55_unpublished_changes
actions: Write git status, binary tracked diff, staged diff and SHA-256 file inventory outside the repository.
Do not remove, overwrite or reset any changed file.
Use an isolated serial-publisher worktree based on the latest origin branch.
Reject deletions, renames, conflicts, invalid JSON/PowerShell and files >=48 MiB until format-aware parts plus SHA-256 manifest exist.
Commit and push normally; retry non-fast-forward at most five times with fetch and merge; verify remote SHA readback.
acceptance: all 55 tracked changes have a remote commit/readback or remain preserved in the snapshot/stash

execution_order.name: stale_git_lock_recovery
actions: Check for active git.exe or git-lfs.exe processes.
Only if none exist, remove zero-byte index.lock, sparse-checkout.lock or shallow.lock files older than 15 minutes.
Never delete non-empty or recent locks.
acceptance: no stale empty Git lock remains
no active Git operation was interrupted

execution_order.name: start_or_preserve_existing_single_runner
actions: Use the canonical starter/launcher only.
If one verified daemon is active, preserve it and start nothing.
If none is active, start exactly one daemon with MaxTasks=1.

execution_order.name: priority_queue_recovery
actions: Allow the existing FIFO/priority coordinator to claim height_difference_2 first.
Do not create duplicate tasks or continuation keys.
After its guarded recovery receipt and port 8012 readback pass, allow existing queued tasks to continue serially.

execution_order.name: slot_acceptance_chain
actions: gas_emissions_2: execute runtime guard/carrier, obtain 100/100 browser acceptance and runtime receipts.
gas_emissions_3: complete existing v11 browser queue, screenshot/DOM proof and 100/100 acceptance.
internet_access_3: run 594 worker tests, 82 source checks, four package hydrations and four checkpoint fingerprints.
ready_to_sell_1: regenerate only the two authorized V53 DOM reports and require 519/12/507/483/1388 plus semantic acceptance.
ready_to_sell_2: execute existing automation-167 worker and record canonical port-8012 DOM truth.
security_public_safety_2: run pinned fast-forward-only timeout-guarded recovery on canonical F root and produce 12 runtime rows.
security_public_safety_3: execute existing v13 worker for 300 rendered rows, 12 pages, zero console errors and pre/post snapshot integrity.
acceptance: each reported blocker predicate is false
associated manual action state is RESOLVED where present

execution_order.name: final_serial_publish_and_readback
actions: Publish runner outputs through the existing serial publisher.
Verify local commit SHA equals remote branch readback.
Update problem_solver and slot manual actions to RESOLVED only after actual evidence exists.

slot_predicates.gas_emissions_3: browser_verified_rows>=100 AND stale runner/queue/recovery blockers absent
slot_predicates.ready_to_sell_1: manual action RESOLVED after accepted V53 JSON+Markdown reports
slot_predicates.security_public_safety_2: manual action RESOLVED or runtime_joined_candidate_rows>=12 and verified_rows>=12
